original_test_intent: Verify the Type 7 Error Correction Type enum for each cache instance accurately reports its approved protection mechanism—such as none, parity, ECC or CRC—and remains stable after reboot; this metadata case does not inject cache errors or prove correction behavior dynamically.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 7 records, retain the raw enum byte per handle/level/designation, decode with the applicable SMBIOS table, compare with the approved processor/cache integrity design and Type 4 links, reboot and repeat without changing ECC or injecting faults.
manual_activity: A user approves expected per-cache correction enums, Unknown/Other policy, topology mapping and reboot plan. Read-only enum validation is automatable.
required_inputs: Expected Cache Error Correction Type for every Type 7 handle/level
Applicable SMBIOS enum table and treatment of Other, Unknown or reserved values
Approved CPU/cache integrity specification and Type 4 relationship map
Explicit statement that no active fault injection is part of this metadata case
Validated raw/decoded parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not enable/disable cache protection, inject hardware errors, alter CPU/cache controls or modify firmware.
Preserve raw enum byte and complete cache identity; a rendered label cannot show reserved values or wrong-record association.
Do not treat the metadata enum as proof that correction circuitry handles injected faults; dynamic RAS validation requires a separate authorized case.
Map Other/Unknown only with approved vendor evidence and retain the raw value.
Stop on undefined/reserved enum, topology mismatch, unexpected drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw/decoded correction enums per cache handle, compare with approved integrity design and persistence before/after reboot.
Do not inject errors, change cache protection or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected correction mechanism per cache and Unknown/Other/vendor handling.
Approve topology/reboot recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep loses raw enum and handle/level context and cannot distinguish read-only metadata validation from functional ECC testing.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 7 records, extract the raw correction enum per handle and validate it against the approved cache integrity design.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Cache Error Correction Type scope, Type 7 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the raw Type 7 correction enum by SMBIOS version, bind it to cache identity/topology, compare it with the approved hardware design and repeat after reboot without active fault stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, CPU/cache design and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 7 Error Correction Type enumeration, approved processor/cache integrity specification and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum provenance, topology binding and an explicit metadata-versus-functional-RAS boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves this field check while preventing an unsupported claim that ECC behavior was exercised.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected enum map and vendor handling policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The field is declarative; it cannot validate detection/correction thresholds, logging or injection response.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve different correction mechanisms by cache level or CPU SKU, including a documented None/Unknown value, but must not count this metadata check as active error-injection coverage.
expected_evidence: Approved per-cache correction enum map, SMBIOS definitions, topology and tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 7 table with handle/level/designation, raw enum and decoded label
Comparison with approved cache integrity design and relevant Type 4 links
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot comparison
Engineer verdict explicitly limited to metadata correctness

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item identifies a canonical Type 7 enum and the persistence criterion is coherent; expected values are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The enum is safely readable and comparable; absent baseline or tooling does not create semantic ambiguity.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw enum, cache identity, topology and the no-error-injection coverage boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its safe no-injection policy while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE and making metadata limitations explicit.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates declarative error-correction type from functional cache RAS behavior and keeps engineer verdict distinct.

review_improvement: Prevents a successful field read from being overstated as active ECC validation and catches reserved/wrong-cache enum defects.
independent_technical_reasoning: Once expected enums and topology are approved, raw extraction, enum decoding, mapping and reboot comparison are deterministic software operations.
